title: The Perfect-Economy Strategy: Pick Your Battles
coreMove: Spend attention, money, patience, and political capital only on fights whose win or loss changes something important.
sourcePressure: Resources are finite, and most winnable fights are still too low-value to deserve the spend.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Avoid conflict permanently and call it strategic economy.

hook: Do not open with a battlefield metaphor for The Perfect-Economy Strategy: Pick Your Battles.
Do not start by saying strategy is not about violence.
counterintuition: Avoid the reusable correction frame that the move is not X but Y.
Avoid a bland paradox about strength looking like weakness.
tryThisNow: No generic timer, pause, breathe, or list-three-options prompt.
No reusable ask what matters most prompt.
examples: No generic founder in a pitch deck unless the domain requires it.
No battlefield reenactment or invented historical anecdote.
